plan.title: How this engine reaches each person
plan.subtitle: A preview for someone who joins today. The AI writes every message from what it knows about the person, and skips a touch that would not help.
plan.firstTouchText: The AI picks the best of {{channels}} for this person and introduces the institute.
plan.followUpText: If they haven't replied or booked yet, the AI follows up with a new angle.
plan.andSoOn: And so on, {{cadence}}, until one of the goals below is met. When someone never responds, the engine slowly waits longer between touches (at most once a month).
plan.replyAuto: The AI answers on WhatsApp right away (outside quiet hours). Money questions, anger, requests to stop and anything it is unsure about come to your inbox.
plan.replyInbox: The reply and a suggested answer land in your task inbox right away, so your team can respond.
plan.capNote: No one gets more than 3 messages a week across all your engines.
